title: Cadence slate governance and SLO-led launch conductor for runtime/console/API
creator: Rohit Menon
description: Problem: As we scale cross-surface launches for runtime, console and the API, teams are repeatedly making ad hoc gating and rollback decisions. This leads to uneven launch quality, late discovery of SLO regressions, and extra on-call load during cutovers. Goal: Create a lightweight, repeatable 'launch conductor' process that governs cadence slates, ties launch windows to SLO thresholds, and provides a single owner-run checklist and escalation flow for go/no-go and rollback decisions. Out of scope: deep infra changes to autoscaling heuristics (those are covered by dedicated ENG tickets).
acceptance_criteria:
A documented launch conductor playbook exists in Confluence with step-by-step go/no-go checks for runtime, console and API surfaces.
  - Playbook includes SLO thresholds (latency P95, error rate), smoke test matrix, and data dashboards to review during decision windows.
A simple YAML cadence-slate definition format and checklist template is agreed with Eng and Design (example in repo) and used for the next two launches.
On-call escalation flow defined and validated: owner, fallback owner, paging policy, and postmortem template — practiced at least once in a dry-run.

Success criteria: for the first production launch using the conductor, mean time to decision (go/no-go) is <= 20 minutes and rollback rate is reduced by 30% compared to the previous similar launch cohort.
Owners from Runtime, Console, API, Observability and Support are signed off in the playbook and the cadence slate for the upcoming launch window.
tasks: Draft initial conductor playbook and cadence-slate YAML schema (PM)
Workshop SLO thresholds and smoke-test matrix with Runtime and Observability (PM + ENG)
Create a Confluence page and copy of the checklist that can be used during cutover windows (PM)
Implement a minimal dashboard slice in Monitor for quick go/no-go review (ENG-Observability)
Run a dry-run rehearsal during staging cutover with on-call to validate escalation flow (cross-team)
Capture lessons and iterate on the checklist; ship final playbook and assign launch conductor for first cohort (PM)
Post-launch retrospective and update templates; decide on inclusion in quarterly launch runbook (PM + Eng)
If successful, roll playbook into Launch Library and automate cadence-slate creation from a simple UI (follow-up project)
